contributions.detail: Schedule A (PDF p3) carries 8 handwritten entries on lines 1-8 of a 17-line grid; lines 9-17 are printed and empty. 647.22 + 25.88 + 1.71 + 12.00 + 10.00 + 50.00 + 0.50 + 1.00 = 748.31 exactly = the schedule's printed page subtotal = its printed total = the cover's promoted per-period Column A cell. Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' also prints 748.31: this is the filer's only report of the cycle ('30 Days after withdraw or elimination', 04-23-18), so period equals year-to-date and the scopes cannot be distinguished on this document; Column A is the promoted anchor and it closed. The summary ladder is internally consistent with a slashed zero at both ends: line 3 beginning 0 + line 4 748.31 = line 5 subtotal 748.31; 748.31 - line 6 748.31 = line 7 close 0.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' line 2 TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (748.31), equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' 748.31 and its printed 'Total Expenditures Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages)' 748.31
expenditures.detail: Schedule B (PDF p4) carries 8 handwritten entries on lines 1-8 of a 17-line grid; lines 9-17 are printed and empty. 647.22 + 25.88 + 1.71 + 12.00 + 10.00 + 50.00 + 0.50 + 1.00 = 748.31 exactly = the printed page subtotal = the printed total = Column A. The eight amounts are the SAME eight figures in the SAME order as Schedule A: this filer books each out-of-pocket payment twice, once as a contribution from himself and once as the expenditure it paid for, which is why contributions equal expenditures to the cent and both balances are zero. That is the document's own construction and was not adjusted.

itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only — tested on BOTH sides of THIS filing (§G1), not inherited. Neither schedule prints an in-kind column and no row carries an in-kind marking, so the monetary-only and monetary-plus-in-kind sums are identical (748.31 on each side) and both close on the printed figures.
itemized.escalation_note: THREE tight-crop escalations, all about legibility/geometry, none of which changed a figure. (1) and (2): the p3 line-1 and p4 line-1 amount cells first rendered CLIPPED inside the printed amount column — '647.2' with the final digit cut on the right on p3, and the leading '6' cut on the left on p4 — the §G2 column-overflow hazard. Re-rendered on a widened box, both read '647.22' complete; the widened box is what this record stores (see frames), and the printed column band is recorded alongside it. Every other amount on the filing was then re-checked against the widened band and none is clipped (the remaining figures are short). (3): the left-margin annotations were cropped at 900-1400 dpi to read them; on p3 the word is legible as 'approximate' against line 5 with ditto marks below it against lines 6 and 7, while on p4 the same three lines are braced with a rotated annotation that is NOT confidently legible (it reads approximately 'per A'). Neither annotation carries a figure nor consumes a printed line, and neither was allowed to alter a value.

itemized.notes: PAGE-FACE candidate 'Timothy William Spencer' (handwritten), party 'Republican', Office Seeking written simply as 'Commissioner' with NO SEAT LETTER — index.csv carries 'County Commission Seat B' from the channel and that seat is NOT inferred or confirmed by this document; index.csv names no candidate, so the page face supplies it. Report type: the INTERIM box '30 Days after withdraw or elimination' is ticked; the amendment question is answered 'No'; signed and dated 04-23-18, and the same date is written in the Date of Report box on all three inner sheets. The document is stamped 'COPY' and the clerk's 'Date received' box is EMPTY — there is no received stamp on this copy. FORM STOCK (§H5): the cover is the county-only title 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5)' and the three inner sheets are GENUINELY 2018-DATED, strap-lined '2018 County Candidate' (summary and Schedule B) and '2018 County CandidateS' (Schedule A) — the same two-wording 2018 stock seen on the Ellingson filing in this chunk, no 2016 leftover. Schedule B's payee column is headed 'Provider/Vendor' and there is NO Purpose column. A NEW FOLIATION PRACTICE, worth recording against the eight already catalogued: this filer increments the TOTAL along with the page, writing 'Page 2 of 2' on the summary, 'Page 3 of 3' on Schedule A and 'Page 4 of 4' on Schedule B, while ALSO hand-numbering the four sheets '- 1 -' to '- 4 -' at the foot including the cover. Read naively, the summary's 'of 2' would say the schedules do not exist; the hand pagination and the pages themselves say otherwise. Page ordinals and foliation locate nothing here — the summary page was located by its printed 'SUMMARY PAGE' heading. FILER HABIT: every figure on the summary page is written once in its cell and then RE-WRITTEN in parentheses beside or below it — (748.31) appears five times — and the schedules' subtotals are written the same way ('748.31 (748.31)'). The repetition is the filer's own confirmation, not a second figure, and both writings agree everywhere. THE TWO SCHEDULES MIRROR EACH OTHER: the same eight amounts in the same order, because this filer records each out-of-pocket payment as a contribution from himself AND as the expenditure it funded; contributions therefore equal expenditures exactly and the beginning and closing balances are slashed zeros (0 under the zero-glyph ruling). ROW-INDEX TRAPS SCREENED: no skipped first line (the §A1 control crop rendered the row-1 figure on both schedules), no banner, no voided row, no continuation line, the §B5 one-past control rendered an empty cell on both pages, and no rowbands band was ~2x pitch, so no doubled band (§H3) exists here; each side's sum closed on its own printed subtotal without any shortfall to explain. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: columns assigned by CONTENT and confirmed against the printed headings — dates in Date, person/business names in Name-of-Contributor and Provider/Vendor, addresses in the address column, money in Amount; no inversion of the §F2/§G3 kind. PRIVACY: this filing is not one of the county's redacted publications; donor and vendor mailing lines are printed in the clear and were reduced at read time — the candidate's own city/state only on the contribution side (from the 'above' pointer his own cells make to the cover), and NOTHING on the expenditure side, which carries no address field in this record.
